doc.name: LLMready
doc.instructions: LLMready audits how well websites can be read by AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) and generates llms.txt files. Start with quick_check: it works without signing in and returns a site's 0–100 score, grade, category scores, AI crawler access and top 3 fixes without saving anything. It's limited to 10 checks a minute and 100 a day per IP address (per account when signed in). Every other tool needs the user to sign in with an LLMready Pro account; calling one without signing in returns a sign-in challenge (HTTP 401) that MCP clients use to start sign-in. With Pro: audit a site for every failing check, prioritized fixes and a shareable report link; generate or validate llms.txt files; list past audits and check remaining credits. Crawling tools cost 1 credit each from the monthly allowance; reads and validation are free. A score measures crawler access and readability — it never guarantees that an AI engine will cite the site, so don't promise that to users.

tools.name: quick_check
tools.title: Quick AI search readiness check (free)
tools.description: Free, no sign-in, Pro or credits needed: 10 checks a minute and 100 a day per IP address (per account when signed in). Checks a public website live and returns its 0–100 AI search readiness score, grade, category scores, which AI crawlers robots.txt allows or blocks, whether llms.txt exists, and the top 3 fixes. Saves no report — audit_url (Pro) lists every failing check with a shareable report and badge.

url.description: Website URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com or example.com

tools.name: audit_url
tools.title: Audit a website for AI search readiness
tools.description: Crawl a public website live and score how well AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) can access and read it: 0–100 score, grade, category scores, prioritized fixes and a shareable report link. Costs 1 credit. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

url.description: Website URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com or example.com

tools.name: get_audit
tools.title: Get a saved audit
tools.description: Fetch a saved audit from your LLMready account by id, including score, failing checks, AI crawler access and fixes. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

id.description: Audit id returned by audit_url or list_audits

tools.name: list_audits
tools.title: List your audits
tools.description: List audits saved on your LLMready account, newest first, optionally for one domain. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

domain.description: Only audits for this domain, e.g. example.com

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.title: Generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt
tools.description: Crawl a website's key pages and generate a spec-compliant /llms.txt plus an /llms-full.txt with page content as Markdown, ready to upload to the site root. Costs 1 credit. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.title: Validate an llms.txt file
tools.description: Check llms.txt content against the llmstxt.org proposal and list errors and warnings by line. Pass `content` to check text, or `url` to fetch and check a site's live /llms.txt. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

url.description: Site URL whose live /llms.txt should be fetched and validated

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Check API credits
tools.description: Show how many LLMready credits are used and left this month. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.
